hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that implements its own bonding curve, routing swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults rather than standard Uniswap v4 pool liquidity. Each instance is deployed as a delegatecall proxy with immutable parameters (price, concentrations, fee) and settles trades by depositing/withdrawing from paired Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass pool liquidity.
